import sys
from itertools import permutations

def main():
    S = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    target = int(S, 16)
    chars = sorted(S)
    found = False
    for p in permutations(chars):
        num = int(''.join(p), 16)
        if num >= target:
            found = True
            result = ''.join(p)
            break
    if found:
        print(result)
    else:
        print("NO")

main()
